end.summary:
Ishita practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
They identified a cake box as a cuboid and a bottle’s straight lower part as a cylinder.
They described a cylinder as having two circular ends and a curved side.
They identified a dice as cube-like and stated that a cube has six faces.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes using familiar objects such as a cake box, bottle and dice. Ishita explained that a cylinder has two circular ends and a curved side, and that a cube has six faces. They asked for pictures and matching controls several times, so using clear shape pictures or real objects at home may help. Ask them to name the shape of a box, bottle, ball and cone-shaped object.
